name: WSV Pegelonline (Germany)
description: Water-level observations for German coastal and estuarine gauges from the Federal Waterways and Shipping Administration (WSV). Surfaces in the place panel for German North Sea and Baltic places.

wsv-pegelonline.purpose: Observed water level + 24 h curve for German coastal places near a WSV station.
wsv-pegelonline.dataReceived: Latest water-level observation and a 30-min curve; derived high/low events from the curve.
